API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsGet Aws Supported Regions
Get Aws Supported Regions
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudInfo/supportedRegions

Retrieves a list of AWS regions supported for workload discovery settings (WDS).

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique ID of the supported region.

name
string

The name of the supported region.

cloudType
string

The cloud type. The default and mandatory value is AWS.

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE, GCP]

]
